Quick debrief from today’s screen (notes below). I’m sending this to the agency so they have a timely update.

Summary:
- Technical: Strong frontend instincts, clear ownership stories. Paired well on a DOM diffing exercise. Backend knowledge is solid but lacks depth on distributed systems tradeoffs (OK for the role’s early-career backend expectations).
- Communication: Clear, good at specifying tradeoffs. Asked clarifying Qs and accepted feedback during pairing.
- Concerns / flags: Would benefit from an extra loop on systems design for larger-scale work; recommended second-stage system-design with a senior backend engineer.

Recommendation: Move to take-home design exercise or schedule a 60-minute system-design with senior backend (I can lead). If they’re open, prioritize a short design follow-up over multiple small screens.

Camila (agency) — can you check candidate interest in a 60-minute design with an engineering lead next week? If yes, we’ll send a proposed slot.
